description: Get WHO health indicator data for a specific country. Specify a 3-letter ISO country code and optionally filter by indicator and year. Useful for country-level health profiles: life expectancy, immunization coverage, maternal mortality, disease burden, and SDG health targets. Use who.dimension_values with dimension="COUNTRY" to discover valid country codes. No auth — WHO public data, unlimited free.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. "USA", "BRA", "KEN", "IND"). Use who.dimension_values with dimension="COUNTRY" to list all valid codes.

indicator_code.description: WHO GHO indicator code to retrieve (default: WHOSIS_000001 for life expectancy). Use who.indicator_search to find codes.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–100, default 20).

year.description: Specific year to retrieve data for (e.g. 2022). Omit to get all available years.

name: who.health.country_data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: WHO GHO — Country Health Data
